articles.headline: Pine Labs profit surges on digital payments boom
articles.brief: Pine Labs reported a massive sixfold profit jump fueled by India's expanding digital payments sector, showcasing surging domestic demand for fintech infrastructure and robust financial transaction volumes.

articles.headline: ECB flags December rate hike amid yield concerns
articles.brief: European Central Bank officials signaled a potential interest rate hike in December while cautioning that rising bond yields could weigh heavily on broader regional economic growth.

articles.headline: US declares national emergency to secure power grid
articles.brief: The US government declared a national emergency across 13 states to protect bulk power systems from foreign-made equipment vulnerabilities, targeting potential cyberattacks and supply disruptions.

articles.headline: Finland launches criminal probe into Google data center
articles.brief: Finnish authorities have initiated a formal criminal investigation into land clearance procedures associated with a planned Google data center development.

articles.headline: IMF warns of Super El Niño risks to India
articles.brief: The International Monetary Fund cautioned that a Super El Niño weather pattern poses material downside risks to India's economic growth trajectory, though the full impact remains pending.

articles.headline: Piyush Goyal targets $1 trillion exports milestone
articles.brief: Union Minister Piyush Goyal stated that India remains fully capable of achieving its ambitious $1 trillion export target this fiscal year despite prevailing global economic headwinds.

articles.headline: Netanyahu's bloc falls short in Israeli elections
articles.brief: Benjamin Netanyahu's political bloc secured 53 seats in the latest Israeli election, falling short of a governing majority and setting the stage for complex coalition negotiations.

articles.headline: China Communist Party conclave records high expulsions
articles.brief: China's ruling Communist Party wrapped up a high-level disciplinary conclave marked by a record number of official expulsions and absences as part of an ongoing anti-corruption drive.

articles.headline: Russian drone strike kills 14 on Ukrainian rail platform
articles.brief: A deadly Russian drone strike hit a Ukrainian railway platform, resulting in the deaths of 14 people and drawing immediate international condemnation.

articles.headline: Canada courts Europe amid US trade pressure
articles.brief: Facing mounting trade pressure and tariff threats from the United States, Canadian representatives are actively pursuing closer economic integration and associate status with the European Union.

articles.headline: Spanish train crash death toll climbs to 69
articles.brief: Emergency responders confirmed that the death toll from a devastating train crash in Spain has risen to 69 as rescue and recovery operations continue at the scene.

articles.headline: Actor Sir Patrick Stewart passes away at 86
articles.brief: Renowned British actor Sir Patrick Stewart, celebrated globally for his iconic roles in Star Trek and the X-Men franchise, has died at his Los Angeles home at age 86.

articles.headline: Kotian claims 11 wickets to anchor Mumbai victory
articles.brief: Tanush Kotian delivered a stellar bowling performance, taking 8 for 84 to complete a match haul of 11 wickets and steer Mumbai to a commanding domestic cricket win.

articles.headline: Health insurers seek regulatory tweaks on expense caps
articles.brief: Industry representatives in India's health insurance sector have petitioned regulators for revisions to management expense caps to ensure sustainable growth and better product distribution.

articles.headline: Study reveals geographic concentration of health PE
articles.brief: A new industry study indicates that the vast majority of private equity investments in India's healthcare sector remain heavily concentrated in the western and southern regions.
